fact_check.claim: April 6, 2026: AY 2026-27 housing application deadline for first- and second-year students, exemption requests included
fact_check.note: brief §2: all first- and second-year students had to complete the application by April 6, 2026. Brief row 'How to request an exemption' says exemptions are requested in the open application period, so the page's pairing is consistent. The page's own 'whether new transfers follow it is not in the brief' hedge is correct.

fact_check.claim: June 22 (2018): date transfers that year learned whether they had campus housing
fact_check.note: brief: 'in 2018 transfers learned on June 22 whether they had campus housing'. Cornell Sun 2018/12 link matches the brief's source.

fact_check.claim: On or about August 1: most Ithaca 12-month leases start; summer transfer shops leftover downtown 'available now' units, sublets, Lansing complexes
fact_check.note: brief: leases end July 31 and the next starts on or about August 1; leftover market is downtown 'available now' units, sublets, Lansing and Northeast complexes. Ithaca Renting downtown link is in the brief.

fact_check.claim: Late August to September of your on-campus year: Collegetown leasing for the following year opens (Cornell Sun 2022)
fact_check.note: brief rows cite the Sun 2022 article: signing before Labor Day, early Sept 2022 openings, search starting in August.

fact_check.claim: For a spring transfer this is the second fall on campus, about 18 months after arrival
fact_check.note: fixed in place: Recomputed: a January 2027 arrival means the Collegetown search for an August 2028 lease opens about August 2027, roughly 7 months after arrival and the first fall after arrival, not the second fall. The 18 months is the gap from arrival to the first lease start (Jan 2027 to about Aug 2028), as the brief says. Old wording blended the two. New wording: 'the first fall after arrival (about August 2027), and the lease it opens starts about 18 months after arrival'. Matches the transfer-housing guide's own timeline.

fact_check.claim: An exemption lasts a single academic year, so a junior or senior transfer reapplies every year
fact_check.note: brief: 'Exemptions last a single academic year; transfers and returning students must reapply each year'.

fact_check.claim: Not in the brief: when a new transfer files the exemption beyond 'during the open application period'
fact_check.note: Page marks a hole; brief says only 'requests accepted during the open application period'. Hedge is correct.

fact_check.claim: Housing guide descriptions: guide covers rules, prices and leasing calendar; transfer guide covers on-campus year, exemption vs lease; listings guide covers leftover units, sublets, semester leases; neighborhoods guide covers rent and walk or bus; roommates guide covers finding housemates and what you owe if one leaves; lease guide covers clauses
fact_check.note: Compared each description to the guides' titles and metas. The six linked guide paths exist and match. The listings meta does not name semester leases, but the descriptor is a modest paraphrase of that guide's scope.

fact_check.claim: Tools: eligibility quiz (transfer exemption), lease-timeline by start term (fall or spring), move-in checklist by situation
fact_check.note: All three tool directories exist, with matching names.
